a.lede: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.
a.title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience

b.lede: Reddit announced in a post by co-founder Steve Huffman that the site will gradually become a "logged-in service," offering limited access to visitors without accounts. [...]
b.title: Reddit to lock content behind logins to fight scrapers
